title: Solar camera aimed at the portal spot on fenced-off ranch

tellings.quote: pointing exactly at the point where Linda Bradshaw says she saw the portal.

plain: Ross Coulthart, an Australian journalist who investigates UFO claims, says that in 2025 he found a solar-powered camera on the fenced-off Bradshaw Ranch near Sedona, Arizona, "pointing exactly at the point where Linda Bradshaw says she saw the portal." Linda Bradshaw once lived on the ranch and reported strange events there, including a doorway-like opening in the air. Coulthart tells Michels he saw the camera himself and reads it as a sign someone is still watching that spot.
